standard_prerequisites.name: On affines the derived tensor product of the sheaves associated to module complexes is the sheaf associated to the derived tensor product of the module complexes
Being in D_QCoh is local on X
On affines objects of D_QCoh are represented by complexes of modules

core_obligations: Part (2): the equality follows from the affine K-flat lemma and the construction of the derived tensor product (proof lines 637-638).
Part (1): membership in D_QCoh is local on X, so assume X = Spec(A) is affine; represent K and L by complexes of A-modules via the affine comparison, and conclude by part (2) (proof lines 639-645).
proof_roadmap: Prove the affine computation formula (2) (proof lines 637-638).
Reduce part (1) to affines by locality and the affine comparison (proof lines 639-645).
